decoded.what-this-host-is: The hostname a reader reaches only by following the discovery document that docs.firecrawl.dev serves (its own record, p-20261007-mintlify-docs-mcp-third-party-discovery-200). It is a Mintlify deployment host answering for a Firecrawl-branded server. Whether this body is identical to the one docs.firecrawl.dev/mcp returns is a comparison between two requests; it was taken in the same pass, appendix (H) sections (09) and (10), and the profile states it.

finding: The mintlify.me deployment hostname that Firecrawl's generated discovery document advertises answered a keyless initialize on 2026-10-07 at 06:05:13Z with HTTP/2 200 and 1,151 bytes, serverInfo 'Firecrawl Docs' 1.0.0, served by Vercel with x-matched-path /_mintlify/mcp/[subdomain]/[transport]. So the unexpected hostname in the discovery document is a live MCP server, not a dead pointer: an agent that follows discovery from a vendor's domain ends up talking to a working server at a hostname belonging to the platform instead.
